title: Cold rebuild: work sessions
summary: Rebuild Sidekick's Sessions from memory: blank editor, no hints, the same tests as the boss.

steps.title: From memory, on purpose
body: Before the boss you rebuild one piece of your Sidekick **cold**: a blank editor, no hints, no solution to peek at, and the same tests the piece passed before.

Why: pulling a solution out of your own memory is what makes it stay there. Rereading feels like learning; recalling *is* learning. If it does not come back, that is useful too: now you know what to review.
The piece is `Sessions`: sort the activity, then one `Aggregate` that stretches the last session or starts a new one.

steps.prompt: With a gap of 20 minutes, how many sessions do `09:00`, `09:20`, `09:41` make?
steps.explain: 09:20 is exactly 20 minutes after 09:00, so it joins. 09:41 is 21 minutes after 09:20, so it starts a new session of zero length.

items: an empty list as the Aggregate seed
steps.explain: Duplicates do no harm (a zero gap joins), and the whole fold is one `Aggregate`.

solution: static List<(DateTime Start, DateTime End)> Sessions(IEnumerable<DateTime> activity, TimeSpan gap) => activity
template: DateTime DojoAt(int h, int m) => new DateTime(2026, 11, 24, h, m, 0);
Dojo.Eq("two sessions, input unsorted", new List<(DateTime, DateTime)> { (DojoAt(9, 0), DojoAt(9, 25)), (DojoAt(10, 30), DojoAt(10, 40)) },
Sessions(new[] { DojoAt(10, 40), DojoAt(9, 10), DojoAt(9, 0), DojoAt(10, 30), DojoAt(9, 25) }, dojoGap));
Dojo.Eq("a gap of exactly 20 minutes joins", 1, Sessions(new[] { DojoAt(9, 0), DojoAt(9, 20) }, dojoGap).Count);
Dojo.Eq("21 minutes splits", 2, Sessions(new[] { DojoAt(9, 0), DojoAt(9, 21) }, dojoGap).Count);
Dojo.Eq("one moment is a session of zero length", new List<(DateTime, DateTime)> { (DojoAt(8, 0), DojoAt(8, 0)) }, Sessions(new[] { DojoAt(8, 0) }, dojoGap));
Dojo.Eq("no activity, no sessions", 0, Sessions(new List<DateTime>(), dojoGap).Count);
var dojoEntries = new List<TimeEntry> { new(1, DojoAt(9, 0), DojoAt(10, 30)), new(2, DojoAt(10, 40), DojoAt(11, 0)), new(1, DojoAt(14, 0), DojoAt(14, 45)) };
var dojoLengths = Sessions(dojoEntries.SelectMany(e => new[] { e.Start, e.End }), TimeSpan.FromHours(2)).Select(s => Sk.FormatMinutes((int)(s.End - s.Start).TotalMinutes)).ToList();
Dojo.Eq("sessions from your time entries (gap 2 h)", new List<string> { "2h 00m", "0h 45m" }, dojoLengths);
enum Status { Todo, Doing, Blocked, Done }
record TimeEntry(int TaskId, DateTime Start, DateTime End)
public static bool CanMove(Status from, Status to) => (from, to) switch
(Status.Doing, Status.Todo or Status.Blocked or Status.Done) => true,

require.message: Builds the sessions with one Aggregate

steps.title: Sessions, cold
prompt: Write `static List<(DateTime Start, DateTime End)> Sessions(IEnumerable<DateTime> activity, TimeSpan gap)`.

Sort the timestamps. A time at most `gap` after the current session's end stretches it; otherwise it starts a new session `(time, time)`. One `Aggregate`, no loops. `Sk.FormatMinutes` and `TimeEntry` are available, as before.
